text:
devon: Quick poll — I found Cachey (the rubber duck) riding the router again. Should Cachey get an official job title? :duck:
jamie: Yes. 'Senior Cache Manager' :+1:
olivia: We already have a Cachey sticker on my laptop so obviously yes. On-call mascot?
marcus: Propose title: 'Chief Cache Validation Officer' (C.C.V.O) :tada:
anya: Can we get a feathered onesie for the next offsite? also remind me of the 'great duck rescue' story pls
devon: Short version: Cachey fell into a box of ethernet cables during the 2024 office move, jamie performed a daring extraction using a cable tie and a sandwich bag. Heroic. (no ducks harmed)
jamie: I demand a commemorative Slack emoji. Please. :duck_parade:
olivia: I'll make the emoji. Which pose? 'Saluting Cachey' or 'Cachey with sunglasses'?
marcus: sunglasses. Also adding a lore clause: new hires must bow to Cachey on week 1.
mochi-bot: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-duck-victory-abc123 (bot-posted)
devon: Vote with a reaction or reply with a title. I'll draft a tiny PR to the handbook if we land on one.
anya: Vote: C.C.V.O from me. :raised_hands:
jamie: :+1:
olivia: put me down for 'On-call Mascot' but I also like CCVO.
marcus: If we get the emoji and a tiny plaque on the router, mission accomplished.
devon: Noted. I'll open a handbook PR and an emoji request. Meeting to decide plaque wording next week?
anya: I'll bring stickers. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
jamie: Legend continues. :sparkles:
